playstyle.identity: Tristana is a scaling ADC with resets and increasing range. Her jump resets on kills, allowing her to bounce through teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack range per level. Q gives attack speed steroid. W rocket jumps (reset on kill or E explosion). E is a bomb that stacks damage with autos - explode for burst. R knocks back and damages. W in, E + autos to stack bomb, W out or reset.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tristana spikes at levels 2-3 for all-in and late with max range. Kraken and crit scale her. She's strong early for kills and late for range.

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.details: Tristana gains bonus attack range as she levels, eventually having one of the longest ranges in the game.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.summary: Gain massive attack speed for a few seconds.
abilities.details: Tristana gains bonus attack speed for several seconds.

abilities.name: Rocket Jump
abilities.summary: Jump to a location; resets on kills and E explosions.
abilities.details: Tristana rockets to a location, dealing damage and slowing on landing. Kills and fully stacked E explosions reset the cooldown.

abilities.name: Explosive Charge
abilities.summary: Place a bomb that explodes after 4 stacks from attacks.
abilities.details: Tristana places a bomb on a target that arms over time or with her attacks. After 4 stacks, it explodes dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Buster Shot
abilities.summary: Knock back an enemy with a blast.
abilities.details: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing damage and knocking back the target. Can add E stacks.
